title: Verdant
description:
A life simulation. Live a whole life, cradle to grave, one year at a time. Choose a career, fall in love, raise a family, build a fortune, and leave a legacy for the next generation to inherit.

A text-based game played in the browser. Choose the desktop or phone layout on the play page. Lives are saved in the browser. Free to play, with optional one-time purchases (expansions such as the Fame Pack, perks such as God Mode).
